_README: Assumption registry. This file did not exist when engine/ev was built --
docs/GOAL.md and contracts/assumptions.json were both absent from the repo
and from its entire history. It is scaffolded here because Models A, B and
STATUS: SCHEMA ONLY. Every value is null and carries a NEEDS_VALUE note.
The engine REFUSES to compute while any required value is null.
An assumption belongs here when it is a JUDGEMENT rather than an
observation. Observations belong in a dated config or in the store.
Every entry carries a rationale and a source so the judgement can be

submission_selection_haircut.NEEDS_VALUE: Multiplier applied to P(10) from the population prior, with the removed mass reassigned to P(9). Decimal fraction in (0, 1]; 1.0 means no haircut.
rationale: Population reports count cards people CHOSE to submit. Submitters
pre-screen, so the pool that reaches the grader is better than the
pool in the wild. Reading a population gem rate as P(10 | this card in
my hands) therefore overstates it. This haircut is the correction.
It is a judgement, not a measurement, which is why it lives here.
submission_selection_haircut.suggested_calibration: Track your own submissions: realised P(10) divided by population gem rate, over at least 30 cards, per game and era.

regrade_conditional_prior.NEEDS_VALUE: P(10 | card already in a PSA 9 slab, no condition read supplied). Decimal fraction. Model B's DEFAULT, deliberately conservative.
rationale: A card already graded 9 is not a random card. PSA saw it and declined
to give it a 10, so the base gem rate is the wrong prior -- it is
conditioned on information the grader already acted on. Model B is
forbidden from using the base gem rate for this reason.
Without a condition read this number should be low enough that the
model discourages the resubmission by default.

conditional_adjustments._NEEDS_VALUE: Multipliers applied to the prior once the user supplies a condition read. Each is a decimal multiplier on the default.

p_downgrade_below_9.NEEDS_VALUE: P(regrade comes back below 9). Non-zero: the card is re-examined by a different grader on a different day.

prior_strength_cards.NEEDS_VALUE: Beta-Binomial prior strength in pseudo-counts, i.e. how many set-level observations the prior is worth. Higher = shrink small-population cards harder toward the set distribution.

min_card_pop_for_own_prior.NEEDS_VALUE: Below this total population, the card's own distribution is not used at all and the set-level distribution is used directly.

fallback_when_no_set_data.NEEDS_VALUE: What to do when neither card nor set has population data: must be the string 'refuse'. Guessing a grade distribution is how a break-even probability becomes fiction.

pull_rate_estimates._NEEDS_VALUE: Model E inputs. ALL of these are flagged low_confidence by construction: community pull-rate data is self-reported, survivorship-biased toward hits, and rarely states a denominator. Model E stamps every result with this flag and it cannot be turned off.

_example_shape.product_id: the sealed product this applies to

rates._NEEDS_VALUE: Map of rarity_band -> probability per pack. Must sum to <= 1 across mutually exclusive bands.

days_to_sell.NEEDS_VALUE: Expected days from listing to settled sale. Feeds annualised ROI together with grading turnaround. Overridable per venue in config/fees.yaml.

acquisition_tax_pct.NEEDS_VALUE: Sales tax / VAT paid on acquisition, as a decimal fraction. 0 if none, not null.

capital_gains_treatment.NEEDS_VALUE: String describing treatment. Models report PRE-TAX returns; this is recorded so the omission is explicit rather than forgotten.

rationale: Model D suppresses any card where either grade's comp sample is below
this in the window. A screen built on three sales is noise wearing a
suit. This one has a real default because it is a methodology floor,

rate_source.NEEDS_VALUE: Where FX rates come from, e.g. a named daily reference rate. Every converted amount stores the rate used and that rate's as-of date.

conversion_spread_pct.NEEDS_VALUE: Spread paid on an actual currency conversion, separate from the marketplace's fx_conversion_pct. 0 if none, not null.
